perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed

perks.name: Fluted Barrel

Ultra-light barrel.

Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.

  •  Increases range

perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

Speeds up charge.
  •  Faster charge time
  •  Decreases impact damage

perks.name: Enhanced Battery

Strong battery life.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Ionized Battery

Large heavy battery.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed

Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Projection Fuse

Distance optimizations.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.desc: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Backup Plan
perks.desc: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for a short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Genesis
perks.desc: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon fills its magazine from reserves. Energy weapons regenerate ammo on hit when matching the damage type to the combatant's shield.

perks.name: Box Breathing
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.
